exposure: sFlt-1/PlGF ratio (measured at study inclusion and at birth)
feto-maternal Doppler parameters (umbilical artery, uterine arteries, ductus venosus, cerebroplacental ratio)
daily percentage increase of angiogenic markers
cohort: The study included 52 pregnant women with fetal growth restriction (FGR).
finding: The sFlt-1/PlGF ratio in maternal serum reflects fetal well-being and placental dysfunction, with a rapid daily increase significantly associated with clinical disease progression and shorter time to delivery.
